answer: Admission runs through SpectrumGate, a verifier that resolves a broadcast call sign and transmitter coordinates against the national license file, refusing any call sign already bound to a seat. The penalty trigger is a duplicated call sign or a second transmitter reporting the same site, revoking both licenses and forfeiting the surety bond. A license costs 1200 dollars, a tower survey 900, an RF proof run 500, so N fakes cost N times 2600 dollars plus N survey days. A grove of antennas on one summit still needs its own license, and no saffron seal hides one fee paid twice.
